title: Ogya no Dansefo
intro: Ankorankoro bi a emu dɔ, a wahyira ne ho so sɛ obehu nokwasɛm a etwa to no, fii akwantu bi ase sɛ obehu honhom mu nneɛma. Wɔn gyidi a enhinhim no ma wɔkasa tiaa gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔde asi hɔ, na wohyiaa sɔhwɛ akɛse a ɛsɔɔ gyidi anohyeto ahorow hwɛe. Saa ɔkra yi asɛm no yɛ ɔsoro ahobanbɔ ne akwankyerɛ ho adanse.
clues: Wɔde abodin soronko bi a efi m’Awurade hɔ hyiraa me, a ɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ a emu dɔ na ɛyɛ soronko.
Me mfitiaseɛ nkwa nna wɔ nnipa bi a wɔkotow ahoni a wɔde nsa ayɛ mu, nanso na me koma kɔn dɔ Nokware Nyankopɔn Baako no.
Mehwɛɛ ɔsoro abɔdeɛ, owia, bosome, ne nsoromma, dwennwen wɔn sɔre ne wɔn asehweɛ ho, na mede baa awieeɛ sɛ wɔrentumi nyɛ m’Awurade.
Wɔ adeyɛ bi a mede tia nyame pii som a atrɛw mu no, me ne atoro anyame no hyiae, na migyaw obi a ɔyɛ ankonam, ɔsõ sen biara sɛ obi a ɔbɔ sobo a ɔyɛ komm.
Abosonsom a mekasa tiae no ma wɔde asotwe a emu yɛ den baa me so, bere a wobuu me fɔ sɛ wɔmfa me nto ogyaframa a ano yɛ den mu no.
Nanso, ɛdenam me Bɔfo ahyɛde so no, ogyaframa a ano yɛ den no danee onwini ne ahobammɔ fibea, na ɛkoraa me nkwa so.

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Ɔde nkurɔfo kɔɔ baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ
Onyaa ahenni kɛse bi fii awo mu

arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
